'''Ebe E. Endocott's Podracer''' was the [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] [[Ebe E. Endocott/Legends|Ebe E. Endocott]] piloted in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] won by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].

Endocott took fourth place in the Boonta Eve Podrace. His racer's engines were configured in a Split-X formation.
